The screen notices, in menu order. tools/notice_atlas.py draws one card per entry into notice-atlas.png, and the Unity generator builds the menu and animator from this same list. `id` names the menu item; `label` is the text on the card (
 breaks a line); `icon` is a wirenook-assets icon name. Append new notices: a notice's position is its card index and its synced parameter value, so reordering would change what an old menu shows.
